title: TESTNAV: Pareto-Guided Search for Compositional Robustness Testing
abstract: arXiv:2608.19882v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning models remain vulnerable to real-world input perturbations, especially when multiple corruptions co-occur in the same input (e.g., brightness shifts and motion blur). Compositional testing reveals these interaction effects but introduces two challenges: combinatorial growth of the perturbation space as dimensions and severity levels increase, and uneven diagnostic value-many combinations yield unrealistically degraded inputs with limited practical relevance.   We present TESTNAV, 1 a Pareto-guided robustness testing framework for efficiently exploring discrete, compositional perturbation spaces when only a limited number of perturbation configurations can be evaluated. translated_title: TESTNAV：帕累托引导的组合鲁棒性测试搜索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19882v1 公告类型：新  摘要：深度学习模型对现实世界中的输入扰动仍然脆弱，尤其是当同一输入中同时出现多种失真（例如亮度偏移和运动模糊）时。组合测试揭示了这些交互效应，但引入了两个挑战：随着维度和严重程度级别的增加，扰动空间的组合增长，以及不均匀的诊断价值——许多组合会产生不切实际且过度退化的输入，实际相关性有限。我们提出了TESTNAV，一个帕累托引导的鲁棒性测试框架，用于在只能评估有限数量的扰动配置时，高效探索离散的组合扰动空间。TESTNAV通过将鲁棒性测试表述为双目标优化，优先考虑严重但现实的失败：最大化性能退化，同时保持由模态特定指标（例如视觉的SSIM和KID；文本的chrF和B）衡量的输入保真度。
tldr: TESTNAV通过帕累托引导的双目标优化，在有限评估预算下高效探索组合扰动空间，优先发现严重且现实的模型失败模式。
en_tdlr: TESTNAV efficiently explores compositional perturbation spaces under limited evaluation budgets via Pareto-guided bi-objective optimization, prioritizing severe yet realistic model failures.
